extraction.notes: Three-month (Q2 2024) column only; all subtotals tie: 2,922 + FFO adjustments = 25,711; + core adjustments = 18,615; + AFFO adjustments = 21,634. Company has no separate AFFO metric; Core AFFO is the AFFO-type total and starts from Core FFO. Building improvements and TI/LC are already deducted in Core AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Diluted share count is NOT printed on these pages: the pages give only OP units (8,689 thousand) in footnote 6, and the total weighted-average diluted count needed for FFO per share is absent, so diluted_shares is entered as 0 as a placeholder and must be filled from the source (the implied count from 25,711/0.25 and 18,615/0.18 is roughly 103 million, but this is an estimate, not a disclosed figure). Items with zero amounts were printed as em-dashes. 'Amortization of derivative premium' is an amortization rather than a fair-value change, so it is coded 'other'. 'Land and other impairments' is coded 'other' because it is a land impairment, not depreciable real estate. Page seq 38/39 repeat the same content as seq 12/13; seq 12 used as the source.
